board: XIAO-class ESP32-S3 (8 MB flash, USB 44:B1:76:B0:E5:8C), build with sdkconfig.xiao
rf: coax with 30 dB attenuation into a USRP B200 (34A6B8E), UHD 4.8.0, 2420 MHz, TX gain 0, peak 128, station KJ5SCH
capture: fc32, 4 MS/s, 2.5 MHz analog bandwidth, master clock 40 MHz, no overflows, 50 s per run (keyed 40 s: two 4.98 s IDs, about 30 s of data)
payload: xorshift32 seed 2026, 40-byte station header per frame, PRNG continues across frames

receivers.stock: LeanSDR 84c59e1 with the repository's builder edits (examples/self-check)
receivers.sf34-fixed: same, with the first row of ldpc_sf_fec34 changed from ncols 3 to 12
